jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

As a production worker early shift, you play a key role in the production process of meat products. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

Your responsibilities include:

 
• Supplying the production line with meat products.
 
• Trimming and cutting meat where necessary to ensure every product meets quality standards.
 
• No knife experience? No problem! Full training is provided on the job.
 
• Assisting with the loading and unloading of goods.
 
• Supporting different departments such as production, packaging, and dispatch.

The variety of tasks makes the role of production worker early shift both dynamic and rewarding.

Do you enjoy hands-on work and staying active throughout the day? Then you could be the production worker early shift we are looking for.

 
• Physically fit and comfortable with manual work.
 
• Willing to work with meat products.
 
• Comfortable working in a chilled environment.
 
• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.
 
• Flexible with early morning starts and shift schedules.
 
• As a production worker early shift, you can communicate in Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian.

Do you dream of a job with no routine work, where you build a unique finished product from A to Z? For a stable and valued family-owned company in the region, we are looking for a mature Structural Metal Worker / Fitter.

 

As a Structural Metal Worker, you are responsible for the full assembly and custom fitting directly onto the truck chassis:

• Reading Blueprint Plans & Preparation: You read complex technical drawings and bending diagrams like second nature. You saw, drill, cut, and work with lasers based on these plans.
• Assembly & Fitting: You assemble parts with precision down to the millimeter. Think of constructing stairs, doors, frames, and specific structures.
• Metalworking & Bending: You perform the necessary bending and drilling work. Logical reasoning is essential here: when a drawing is challenging, you know exactly how to make the parts fit together seamlessly.
• Light Welding: A small part of your duties includes MIG/MAG welding (assembling/tack welding). However, the main focus is on total assembly.

 Jouw profiel als Constructiemedewerker / Samensteller.

• Experience & Maturity: You have already gained solid and relevant experience in metal construction, assembly, or fitting (e.g., custom doors, stairs, or structures). Due to the complexity of the work, we are looking for a mature candidate who can work independently.
• Technical Insight: You excel at reading blueprint drawings, have excellent spatial awareness, and can reason logically.
• Metalworking Skills: You have experience with various metalworking techniques (drilling, bending, cutting). Experience with or training in MIG/MAG welding is a nice plus, but not a requirement!
• Language Skills: You communicate fluently in English.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for a Purchase Order Manager. You will report to the Finance Manager.

This is not a procurement role. Instead, it is a finance-focused position where accounting knowledge, financial controls and process governance are essential.

• 
Lead, coach and develop a team of Finance Operations professionals.

• 
Ensure the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders.

• 
Maintain the quality and integrity of vendor master data while ensuring compliance with financial controls.

• 
Partner closely with Accounting to support accurate financial reporting, month-end close and reconciliation activities.

• 
Collaborate with Finance and cross-functional teams to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality operations.

• 
Support ERP enhancements, finance transformation initiatives and business integration projects.

• 
Drive continuous improvement of Purchase-to-Pay processes, financial controls and operational efficiency.

• 
Act as the key contact for Finance Operations, providing expert support to internal stakeholders.

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s in accounting, finance, economics, or equivalent experience.

• 
Several years experience in accounting/controlling.

• 
3+ years in financial management/leadership; experience with system-driven procurement processes.

• 
SAP MM/FI, S/4HANA, advanced Excel, and strong Microsoft Office skills.

• 
Fluent in English and Dutch or French.

Do you have what it takes to shine as a true forklift hero in the frozen food industry? 

Then we have the perfect challenging position for you! This company, located in Ardooie, is a global player in the development, processing, and marketing of fresh-frozen products such as vegetables, fruit, herbs, and ready-made meals. We need YOU to join our team! 

As a forklift driver working 2 shifts, you'll play a crucial role in our production process. Showcase your talents and embrace the following tasks with pride: 

 
• Confidently and expertly operate the forklift to load, unload, and move goods within the refreshing frozen food environment (-18 degrees Celsius). 
 
• Your precision and care ensure that products are stacked correctly and stored in their designated locations. 
 
• You'll perform warehouse activities with the utmost care, such as counting and checking goods and accurately recording data. 
 

 
• You're a true safety hero and actively contribute to maintaining our high safety standards and promoting a positive work environment. 
 
• You'll collaborate with great colleagues and other departments to ensure smooth production flows. 

Requirements for this adventurous forklift driver role: 

 
• You have a valid forklift certificate OR can demonstrate experience as a forklift driver. 
 

 
• Don't be afraid to brave the cold, as you'll be showcasing your forklift skills in a deep-freeze environment with temperatures down to -18°C. Your forklift cabin is heated! 
 

 
• Your eye for detail and accuracy make you the king/queen of precision work. 
 

 
• You're a true team player and communicate easily with your colleagues. 
 
• You speak fluent English and are willing to learn Dutch. The company offers Dutch lessons before or after your shift.

jobs.occupation: Pilot Line Process Engineer – Atomic Layer Deposition
jobs.description:
What you will do
 

The Pilot Line Engineer is responsible for: 
 
 

• Daily follow-up of process & tool qualification, stability, improvements and problem prevention.  

• Troubleshoots issues related to the processing and enables first and second line trouble shooters to step up.  

• Investigates recurring issues, focusing on root cause analysis and structural solutions.  

• Keeps focus on quality and reproducibility, monitoring stability and taking actions in case of process fluctuations.  

• Designs experimental plans and executes them in the cleanroom, performing data analysis and taking care of reporting and documentation.  

• Works in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts.  

• Works in a two-shifts system (Early/Late) including 1weekend (Sa/Su) out of 4.  

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or in Engineering or equal to this by experience, and you display strong engineering skills and mindset.  

• You are able to rapidly adapt to changes in circumstances by being able to change priorities at very short notice.  

• A process & quality driven problem solver: you manage multiple priorities in a flexible manner in a continuously changing environment with a proactive “can do” attitude.  

• You take ownership and you enjoy completing your tasks autonomously.  

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required.  

• You are a flexible team player, and you enjoy working in environments where experiences and knowledge are shared with colleagues.  

• Given the international character of imec, fluency in English is a must.

Comecer is expanding its international Service Team! To strengthen our team in Belgium, we are looking for 
Field Service Engineers, preferably based in the 
Brussels–Leuven region. You will be employed by Orise NV 
(former Process Automation Solutions), based in Belgium, and part of ATS Corporation, while working closely with Comecer Netherlands BV and the wider Comecer team.
 

In this role, you will help install, maintain and support high-tech systems that play a critical role in the (radio)pharmaceutical and nuclear medicine sectors.
 

Comecer’s solutions are developed and manufactured in Joure (The Netherlands) and are used in complex laboratory environments worldwide.
 

 
 

What you will do
 

In this role, you will be 
responsible for installing, servicing, and maintaining Comecer equipment at customer sites throughout Belgium. You will carry out both preventive and corrective maintenance, ensuring that each system performs optimally and meets all operational requirements. In addition, you will provide 
training and technical support to end users, helping them understand and operate the equipment effectively. Throughout every assignment, you will communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal teams, representing Comecer as a trusted, solution-oriented technical expert.

What you bring
 

You bring hands‑on experience in repairing technical equipment and troubleshooting both mechanical and electrical issues. You are able to read and interpret electrical, pneumatic and mechanical drawings, and you have a background in electronics, electromechanics or mechanical engineering. In this role, strong communication skills and a customer‑focused attitude are essential, along with a willingness to travel within Belgium and occasionally abroad. You have an energetic, proactive and solution‑driven mindset.
 

Requirements:
 
 

• Technical degree at secondary or bachelor level (electromechanics, electronics or mechatronics). 

• Strong English and French skills; Dutch is an advantage. 

• Experience with PLC-controlled systems is considered as a plus. 

• Valid category B driving licence.

About the Role
 

At D’Ieteren, we have been moving people forward for more than 200 years. Today, we continue to shape the future of mobility through flexible, innovative and customer-focused solutions.
 

Volkswagen D’Ieteren Finance is the Belgian market leader in financing and mobility services for the vehicle brands of the D’Ieteren Group.
 

We are looking for an experienced 
Technical Application Manager to manage and further develop a portfolio of customer-, dealer- and fleet-facing digital applications.
 

What Will Your Role Involve?
 

You will be responsible for websites, digital portals, pricing and calculation solutions, SaaS platforms, APIs, integrations and middleware components.
 

Acting as the link between business stakeholders, Product Owners, Solution Architects, internal IT teams and external partners, you will ensure that the applications meet business needs and remain stable, secure, compliant and future-ready.
 

This is a technical coordination and steering role. You will not develop applications yourself, but you will need a solid IT background to understand technical topics, assess risks, challenge suppliers and translate business requirements into sustainable solutions.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Managing the full lifecycle of the applications in your portfolio. 

• Defining and maintaining the technical roadmap in line with business priorities and enterprise architecture. 

• Ensuring application stability, availability, performance, security and compliance. 

• Overseeing APIs, integrations and middleware services. 

• Assessing the technical impact, risks and dependencies of new initiatives. 

• Coordinating projects, testing, releases and application changes. 

• Steering SaaS providers, implementation partners and other external suppliers. 

• Monitoring service levels, incidents, KPIs and supplier performance. 

• Supporting IAM, PAM and third-party risk-management processes. 

• Maintaining clear and up-to-date application documentation. 

• Identifying opportunities to improve performance, simplify processes and optimise costs.  

 
 

 

Does This Profile Match You?
 
 

• You have at least five years of relevant experience in application management, technical project management, service delivery or technical product management. 

• You have worked with digital platforms, customer portals, SaaS solutions or other business-critical applications. 

• You have a solid understanding of APIs, integrations, middleware and cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure. 

• You can translate business needs into sustainable technical solutions and confidently challenge external service providers. 

• You understand application lifecycle management, IT service management, security and compliance requirements. 

• You are proactive, structured and highly organised, with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently.  

Experience in automotive finance, leasing, fleet management, banking, insurance or another regulated environment is an advantage. You are fluent in English and have a professional level of Dutch or French; knowledge of all three languages is a plus.

• 
Design machines, tools and machine elements.

 
• 
Manage work project planning and project budget.

 
• 
Perform other duties within the team as requested or as deemed appropriate.

 
• 
Conform with the environmental policy and procedures and with the requirements of the environmental management system.

 
• 
Be responsible for the development and the release of all manufacturing documents related to machine and product builds.

 
• 
Be responsible for supporting and delivering new manufacturing technologies to improve competitiveness and project profitability.

 
• 
Ensure Engineering Change Requests (ECR) & Manufacturing Change Requests (MCR) are followed up and implemented as projected.

 
• 
To promote a people first and safety first mindset

 
• 
A degree in mechanical, design, manufacturing or electrical engineering or equivalent work experience

 
• 
At least 3 years of relevant work experience in an design engineering role

 
• 
Math skills which include the practical use of algebra, trigonometry and analytical geometry

 
• 
Experience using 2D and 3D modelling CAD drafting software (Autodesk Inventor skills required)

 
• 
Ability to read, understand, and create engineering drawings and BOM (Bill of Materials)

 
• 
Professional quality written, oral communication and technical writing skills

 
• 
Ability to manage multiple projects, work schedules, and accounting budgets

 
• 
Ability to supervise and direct others in a professional manner and maintain a high degree of accuracy in all aspects of work

 
• 
Fluent English language skills, Dutch and/or French are a plus (Dutch is the daily team communication language)

For our client, a global leader in roll-on/roll-off cargo handling and storage, we are looking for a motivated Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator.

As a Pre-Delivery Inspection Operator, you ensure that every vehicle leaves the premises in top condition. You carry out inspections, prepare vehicles for delivery and make sure any defects or damage are identified and reported correctly.

Preparation and inspection

 
• 
You drive the vehicles through the car wash.

 
• 
You check that all functions are working properly, including the radio and battery.

 
• 
You inspect the tires.

 
• 
You carry out a thorough inspection to identify any damage.

 
• 
You mark any detected damage for the repair department.

Finishing and preparing for delivery

 
• 
You check and confirm the license plates.

 
• 
You equip the vehicles with a fire extinguisher, warning triangle and manuals.

 
• 
You vacuum and clean the vehicle interiors.

Other tasks

 
• 
You move vehicles to the correct zones on the premises.

 
• 
You report defects or deviations to the responsible person in a timely manner.

 
• 
You upload software updates.

What we expect from you

 
• 
You speak Dutch and/or English well enough to communicate fluently with your colleagues.

 
• 
You have a valid driving license and can drive both manual and automatic vehicles.

 
• 
You have the technical insight needed to identify and assess damage.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we don't just design solutions—we engineer the future with bold ideas and a hands-on approach. Our mission is to rethink what's possible in engineering and R&D. Though our team is small, our ambitions are anything but. We move fast, think big, and are driven by curiosity and a shared passion for innovation.
 

About the role
 

Join our R&D team as a Mechanical Design Engineer , where you'll contribute to the development of cutting-edge axial flux motors. 
 

This is what you'll do: 
 
 

•  

Design innovative solutions for new product challenges. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D drawings following industry standards. 
   
 

•  

Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors on design and specifications. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in mechanical design and development. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Skilled in DFMEA, DFM, DFA, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing. 
   
 

•  

Knowledgeable about material properties (metals and plastics), production techniques, and problem-solving methodologies. 
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills to perform mechanical calculation (eg: reaction forces, bolt sizing, bearing selection).
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent in English.

Traxx is looking for a Mechanical and Thermal Simulations Engineer to join our rapidly growing team. You will be responsible for the structural and mechanical simulation of our axial flux motors and their components, while supporting the development and validation of thermal models for our motors and inverters. 
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Strengthen the Simulation Team by improving our structural and mechanical simulation capabilities. 
   
 

•  

Perform structural FEA simulations to evaluate strength, stiffness, fatigue, vibration, and thermal-mechanical behavior of motor components.
   
 

•  

Support the development and validation of thermal simulation models for axial flux motors and power electronics.
   
 

•  

Develop analytical models to complement simulation results and support design decisions.
   
 

•  

Design tests and prototypes required to validate analyses, and correlate simulation results with experimental data.
   
 

•  

Perform root cause analyzes of product and process issues and provide simulation driven recommendations for design improvements.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Deep understanding of electromagnetism and at least 2 years of hands-on experience with electromagnetic simulations.
   
 

•  

Basic understanding of different engineering domains: mechanics, NVH, thermodynamics, ...
   
 

•  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
   
 

•  

Proficiency in Ansys Maxwell, Jmag, Altair or similar as well as Python
  

•  

Strong English communication skills (both written and verbal), good collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively across teams within the organizations.

Boury is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant with international recognition for its precision, refinement, and uncompromising quality standards. Our kitchen operates at the highest level of contemporary gastronomy, where craftsmanship, discipline, and perfection are at the heart of everything we do.
 

We are looking for an experienced, structured, and creative baker. In this role, you will be responsible for the daily production of bread and bakery products at the highest gastronomic level. You will work closely with the kitchen team to ensure consistency, quality, and flawless execution, directly contributing to the overall guest experience.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Preparing and baking artisan breads and bakery products according to Boury’s quality standards; 

• Managing the daily mise en place and production planning for bakery products; 

• Contributing to a professional, disciplined, and team-oriented working environment; 

• Continuously striving for improvement in techniques, efficiency, and quality. 
 

• You have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience within a high-quality bakery or gastronomic environment. 

• You have a genuine passion and interest in products, craftsmanship, and the continuous pursuit of excellence. 

• You are motivated to work at the highest gastronomic level and have an eye for detail, consistency, and quality. 

• You are comfortable working during weekends and understand the commitment required within a top-level culinary environment. 

• Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus. 

• You are a team-oriented professional with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a willingness to continuously improve your techniques and contribute to the team.

At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values —"We Care. We Work. We Win.”— we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress. 

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe! 

Create a new future. Apply Today.
 

 
 

Position overview:
 

The role supports the EHS Manager to ensure and safeguard environmental, health and safety (EHS) aspects, fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. Also he/she will provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, and any other safety, health, well-being issues. Safety Advisor will support EHS Manager with daily management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. The job position helps coordinate EHS activity.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Point of contact for the external service personnel responsible for psychosocial aspects, occupational hygiene, ergonomics, and occupational medicine. 

• Assist in the identification of hazards. Provide advice on appropriate risks and propose possible (preventive) measures. 

• Provide training within the framework of a stable safety culture. 

• Provide advice and proposals regarding the purchase of work equipment, PPE, and the layout of workplaces. 

• Drafting the Annual Action Plan and the Global Prevention Plan. Maintaining records regarding occupational accidents and reporting them. Implementing the annual action plan. 

• Investigating workstations, conducting a thorough, in-depth examination of the workplaces and workstations. 

• Drafting safety instructions. 

• Providing advice and supervision regarding fire prevention. 

• Identifying, relevant, and inventorying risks. Supporting solutions and their implementation. 

• Objectively document and record on-site findings in a report. Collect additional information useful for the report. 

• Handle the administrative follow-up of the execution of assignments and decisions made. Gather and classify all documents in the file. Prepare reports in accordance with regulations. 

• Prepare risk analyses and job description sheets. 

• Organize medical examinations in collaboration with the external service.  

 
 

What Are We Looking For?
 
 

• Level I or II Prevention Advisor certification. 

• Experience of min 2-3 years as Safety Advisor. 

• Experience in industry. 

• Fluent English and Dutch.

For a large-scale industrial project in the 
Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced 
Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) Inspector.
 

You will join an international project environment within the petrochemical industry, where 
English is the main working language. Your focus will be on ensuring that all electrical and instrumentation works are executed safely, correctly and in accordance with project specifications, applicable standards and approved documentation.
 

Your role
 

As an E&I Inspector, you will be closely involved in the construction, installation and pre-commissioning phases of the project. You will spend a significant amount of time in the field, following up contractors and verifying the quality and compliance of the E&I installations.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Inspecting electrical and instrumentation installations during construction and completion 

• Verifying installations against approved drawings, specifications, datasheets and relevant standards 

• Checking cable routing, cable trays, cable pulling and termination 

• Inspecting junction boxes, field instruments, panels, switchgear and other E&I equipment 

• Checking instrument installation, impulse tubing and associated hook-ups 

• Verifying grounding, bonding and earthing installations 

• Performing and witnessing electrical and instrumentation tests 

• Following up loop checks, continuity tests, insulation resistance tests and functional testing 

• Verifying installations in hazardous areas and checking compliance with 
ATEX requirements 

• Reviewing inspection and test records, punch lists and construction documentation 

• Identifying non-conformities and following up corrective actions with contractors
